Do not edit after benchmarks exist; change = new version + explicit note. kind: invariant = must hold exactly, proven by construction/tests (evidence-backed by the executable tests, not by external sources); provisional_design = engineering placeholder with NO external evidence source (gap-matrix G05/E04/B04/B06 UNKNOWN); report_only = measured and reported, no pass/fail.

protocol.scenario: scenarios/s01w2_occlusion_rig.yaml (CCTV cctv_k1 publishes to receiver 'ego'; 11 s simulated)

definitions.delivery_ratio: messages admitted / messages sent (after loss, corruption, duplication handling, admission)
definitions.network_latency: t_recv - t_sent in simulation time for every delivered copy
definitions.obs_to_use_latency: t_proc - t_meas (simulation time) for every ADMITTED message (observation time is preserved end to end)
definitions.aoi: observation-time AoI at the receiver: t - freshest admitted t_meas, sampled every 10 ms from the first admission until the end of the run, pooled over seeds
definitions.bandwidth: serialized TrackMsg bytes handed to the channel per second, per source; canonical JSON bytes (NOT CPM/SDSM encoding)

thresholds.basis: sent = dropped + delivered + in_flight; delivered = admitted + rejected
